class.name: JRPGMapData
class.brief_description: The data of one JRPG map: tile layers, shadows, regions and the map's properties.
class.description: Each map is a scene whose root [JRPGMap] holds its [JRPGMapData] as a built-in resource, so map edits follow the scene's own undo history. Tools and servers read it without creating nodes ([method JRPGMapFiles.read_map_data]). The four tile layers hold one palette index of the map's tileset per cell, row by row (0 for an empty cell). An autotile or wall cell holds only its kind; [JRPGAutotileResolver] picks the shape it shows. Shadows (four quarter bits) and regions (0 to 255) take one byte per cell. Every array always holds [code]size.x * size.y[/code] cells: data of another shape is fitted with a warning.

method.name: bump_revision
method.description: Raises [member revision] by one. A [JRPGMap] whose cells or layout changed calls it when the editor saves its scene, so a game saved before can tell the map was edited.

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns the palette index at [param cell] of [param layer] (one of [enum Layer]), or 0 outside the map.

method.name: get_cell_index
method.description: Returns the position of [param cell] in the layer, region and shadow arrays (row by row).

method.name: get_layer
method.description: Returns the palette indexes of [param layer], row by row.

method.name: get_region
method.description: Returns the region (0 to 255) of [param cell], or 0 outside the map.

method.name: get_resolver_flags
method.description: Returns the [JRPGAutotileResolver] flags of this map drawn with a tileset whose edge mode is [param edge_mode]: its looping axes from [member scroll_type] and the edge mode.

method.name: get_shadow
method.description: Returns the shadow quarters (4 bits) of [param cell], or 0 outside the map.

method.name: has_cell
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] is inside the map.

method.name: paint
method.description: Writes [code]values[i][/code] to the cell at position [code]cells[i][/code] (from [method get_cell_index]) of [param layer], as one paint stroke or undo step. Cells outside the map are skipped with an error. Emits [signal cells_changed] once.

method.name: paint_regions
method.description: Writes regions (clamped to 0 to 255) to the cells at the given positions. Emits [signal cells_changed] with layer -1.

method.name: paint_shadows
method.description: Writes shadow quarters (the low 4 bits of each value) to the cells at the given positions. Emits [signal cells_changed] with layer -1.

signal.name: cells_changed
signal.description: Emitted when cells of [param layer] (-1 for regions and shadows) were painted. [param cells] holds their positions.

signal.name: layout_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the size, the tileset, the scroll type or whole arrays changed, so views build everything again.
